name: Joseph & Lindsey
overview: Joseph and Lindsey are a famous, talented, and wealthy young couple who reside in their hometown of Plotagon City, and have earned the title of Plotagon City's most famous and richest couple. They have appeared in films and television shows, including their favorite, Love Birds. Joseph's siblings and friends support him and Lindsey's relationship; however, Joseph's incarcerated and maniacal ex-girlfriend Beryl opposes the relationship.

seasons.name: Specials
seasons.overview: These are the specials from Joseph & Lindsey, updating you on what's going on.

seasons.name: J&L Season 1
seasons.overview: After Lindsey found Joseph attractive, it was time for Lindsey and Joseph to take it a whole another level. Season 1 of Joseph & Lindsey premiered on March 23, 2020.

seasons.name: Linseph
seasons.overview: Joseph and Lindsey made it official and become Linseph. No, they aren't married yet, but after a year, they decided to make their couple name Linseph. Season 2 of Joseph & Lindsey (Linseph for its 2nd season until 3rd season) premiered on April 23, 2020.

seasons.name: J&L Season 3
seasons.overview: Money disappearing and high priced bread is affecting the Plotagon City, but that doesn't stop Linseph! After Joseph and Lindsey's relationship money disappears, they still continue their relationship, known as Linseph.

seasons.name: J&L Season 4
seasons.overview: After two girls have asked Joseph out to go on a date, he has been angry because the two girls couldn't accept that he was taken by Lindsey, but his mood never changed permanently. Joseph & Lindsey, a couple in Plotagon City who are famous for being rich and being on a TV show, are both meant to be the perfect couple according to their fans.

seasons.name: J&L Season 5
seasons.overview: The money disappearing and high priced bread are now solved after three seasons, meaning that Joseph & Lindsey's relationship money is back after it disappeared. They have gotten more popular since the problems are solved, and they are still Linseph.

seasons.name: J&L Season 6
seasons.overview: Now, there are more problems gaining in Plotagon City. The RAIVirus, the computer virus, still continues to spread worldwide through computers, and Karens are introduced. But that still doesn't stop Joseph & Lindsey! Joseph has became a chef at a local diner called DaDa's diner because of his immaculate cooking!

seasons.name: Joseph & Lindsey: The Wealthy Couple
seasons.overview: Joseph & Lindsey now experience what it feels like being the wealthiest couple ever in Plotagon City, spending their money wisely. Fans are now becoming big fans of Joseph & Lindsey.

seasons.name: Josesey
seasons.overview: Joseph is now hiring bodyguards to protect his house from his enraged ex-girlfriend, Beryl, who wants him back. But he is stuck with a decision to hire bodyguards or become one.

seasons.name: The Ghosts in Plotagon City
seasons.overview: There are now two ghosts in Plotagon City, but the thing is, they are friendly. To some people, they are considered a problem and a bad influence to the city, since some people are afraid of ghosts, but to most people, like Joseph & Lindsey, the ghosts are not a problem.

seasons.name: The Hostile Divorce
seasons.overview: No, Joseph and Lindsey aren't breaking up since they haven't married yet. This is about Boris and Doris, Caillou's parents, who have officially divorced due to a circumstance that transpired. According to Joseph, the only ways to keep the issue from getting worse are for Boris and Doris to refuse to speak to one other until they have resolved the matter, and to avoid exacerbating the issue.

seasons.name: The Reconciliation
seasons.overview: Boris accepted Doris' apology, and the two of them have rekindled their love after overcoming their difficulties. Some people are perplexed as to why Boris accepted Doris' apologies after she had destroyed and nearly burnt down his house.

seasons.name: Time Travel
seasons.overview: Joseph and Lindsey both discover the handcrafted time machine that Joseph's high school friend created, with Joseph revealing that he assisted him in its construction. Joseph doesn't want anybody but his friends and family to know about the time machine, so he instructs them not to tell anyone else. Joseph, Lindsey and the crew strive to travel through time to glimpse their past and future.

seasons.name: Sibling Rivalry
seasons.overview: William and Kristen are starting to not get along with each other because they suspect each other of stealing their possessions, which leads to arguments. Despite their disdain for him, Joseph and Lindsey attempt to assist William in his position. They want him to speak with Kristen, but when he does, things don't go as planned.

seasons.name: Halloween Disaster
seasons.overview: Someone is on the run after committing a suspected murder, and all people of Plotagon City have been ordered to remain indoors until the culprit is captured. Following the announcement, Joseph, Lindsey, and the rest of the crew continue to prepare for Halloween while keeping an eye out for danger.

seasons.name: Dinosaurs
seasons.overview: Jeremy's dinosaur siblings pay Jeremy, Joseph, Lindsey, and the rest of the gang a visit. They are friendly dinosaurs, just like their older brother Jeremy. When Jeremy's siblings visit, he and his siblings are more well-known in public due to the fact that they are the only dinosaurs in Plotagon City. Some individuals believe that dinosaurs are a problem, and they are against them.

seasons.name: Alien Alienation
seasons.overview: Hannah and Lyndon have broken their five-year relationship because Hannah accused him of cheating on her with his cousin Ashley. Lyndon gets depressed after their separation, reminiscing on all of the bright moments he and Hannah shared. Lyndon's relatives and friends outside the crew, as well as Joseph and the rest of the crew, do their hardest to cheer him up and help him and Hannah reconcile.

seasons.name: Thanksgiving Disaster
seasons.overview: According to news outlets such as Plot News 10, all of the Thanksgiving food in both Plotagon City and Plot Benning has been poisoned by mistake. Everyone in those areas is advised not to consume the Thanksgiving meal until the poison has been removed, as consuming poisoned Thanksgiving food would result in death. After hearing the news, Joseph, Lindsey, and the rest of the team are unsure what to eat for Thanksgiving.

seasons.name: A Very Joseph & Lindsey Christmas
seasons.overview: Christmas is approaching, and Joseph, Lindsey, and the rest of the team are getting in the holiday mood early by decking out Joseph's home with decorations. The entire crew, including Joseph and Lindsey, has planned Christmas-related activities, such as last-minute Christmas shopping with other friends.

seasons.name: A Very Joseph & Lindsey Christmas 2
seasons.overview: Christmas and Winter are approaching, and Joseph and Lindsey have begun exchanging gifts with each other and their close friends. New Year's Eve is approaching, and Joseph, Lindsey, and the rest of the team have already made plans for their resolutions for the next year. Joseph and Lindsey have plans to conduct more Christmas-related activities this year, such as Joseph continuing to dress up as Santa Claus to make other children happy, more Christmas shopping, and watching Christmas movies. Despite the fact that there have been recalls on ugly Christmas sweaters and Christmas trees due to Plotagon City's rapid depletion and strange things being found in both, Joseph and Lindsey still enjoy Christmas together!

seasons.name: The New Year
seasons.overview: The year 2022 is approaching, and Joseph, Lindsey, and the rest of the team are already planning their New Year's resolutions. The team holds parties, watches movies, makes bucket lists, and eats special dishes to celebrate. However, Joseph and Lindsey's plans for the New Year may be cancelled due to unforeseen circumstances, but that won't stop them from celebrating! Joseph and Lindsey also celebrate New Year's Eve by doing some last-minute shopping and playing some fun party games.

seasons.name: Employment Problem
seasons.overview: Carrie, Joseph and Lindsey's friend, is having trouble adjusting to her new work at The Plotagon Café. She had lately quit her work but returned. Her job pays well, but there are some rude customers, including Karens, who rate The Plotagon Café as overrated and uninteresting, all because she is the only employee in the Café. The low and medium ratings, with only a small percentage being high, make her want to quit again, which she is persuaded not to do. Joseph, Lindsey, and the rest of the group assist her in resolving her employment issues.

seasons.name: More Alien Beings
seasons.overview: Lyndon's alien siblings are all coming to town to meet him because they haven't seen him in a few years. The reason they haven't seen each other in a long time is unclear, but despite the fact that they annoy Lyndon, they manage to get along much better now, and Lyndon still loves his siblings. Lyndon's siblings tend to get along well with Joseph, Lindsey, and the rest of the crew, and they appear to be their biggest supporters.

seasons.name: The Couple
seasons.overview: Wayne and Marie, Joseph and Lindsey's best pals, are now confirmed to be dating, and neither Joseph, Lindsey, nor the rest of the crew are against them being together. Instead, Joseph, Lindsey, and the rest of the team believe Wayne and Marie are a good match. Some, though, begin to believe otherwise, as they dislike the couple.

seasons.name: One-sided Affection
seasons.overview: Despite the fact that William has a crush on a woman named Anna, she prefers Wayne, despite the fact that he is too old for her and has a girlfriend. Notwithstanding Anna's repeated rejections of William, he continues to fall for her, making her angry and uncomfortable. When Joseph, Lindsey, and the rest of the crew learn that William has a crush on Anna, they try to prevent it by telling him that Anna has a thing on Wayne instead, as well as convincing Anna that Wayne is too old for her and that he is already dating Marie.

seasons.name: The Jealousy
seasons.overview: Carmen, Claude's best friend from high school, travels from Plot Benning to Plotagon City to meet him. She has a crush on Claude, but he is unable to reciprocate because he already has a girlfriend. William is upset and resentful when he learns that Carmen likes Claude regardless of the fact that Claude has a girlfriend. Despite the fact that he is younger than Carmen and prefers younger females, William continues to be enamored by her and makes several attempts to win her affection, only to fail. Joseph, Lindsey, and the rest of the team, including Claude, are irritated because he had already tried this with Anna. They try to stop William's infantile flirting with Carmen.

seasons.name: Double Girlfriends
seasons.overview: Claude has finally chosen to accept Carmen's date request while maintaining his relationship with his longtime lover Miranda. Others believe that Claude dating Miranda and Carmen is a bad idea, but because Claude was able to talk things out with Carmen and Miranda, they are now friends. Joseph, Lindsey, and the crew approve of the polyamorous relationship and think Claude is lucky, however William is even more envious and disapproves of the relationship because he has liked both Carmen and Miranda despite their rejection of him.

seasons.name: Love Confession
seasons.overview: Avery's friend Courtney relocates from Plot Benning to Plotagon City in order to express her love to Avery. After that, Avery accepts her date request, and the two of them start dating. Joseph, Lindsey, and the rest of the crew, including Avery and Courtney, try everything they can to keep Avery and Courtney's love hidden from the public and their enemy, William, who will be jealous and try to break them up and make Courtney his girlfriend. Because William doesn't know Courtney and is jealous of her dating Avery, this will irritate Joseph, Lindsey, and the rest of the group.

seasons.name: Love Betrayal
seasons.overview: Avery finds out Courtney attempted to hook up with his brother Lyndale, and Avery and Courtney's relationship came to an end as a result. After they break up, Joseph throws Courtney out of his house, and the rest of the gang, including Avery and Lyndale, has never trusted her since. Courtney has apologized to Avery and pleaded with him to give her a second opportunity so that she and Avery may try their relationship again, but Avery has refused. Courtney tried to find a boyfriend over time, but it didn't work out, and Joseph, Lindsey, and the crew now feels it's a poor idea for her to do so.

seasons.name: The Chickens
seasons.overview: After escaping from a barn in Plotville, talking colorful chickens travel to Plotagon City to explore city life. All of the chickens are allowed to stay at Joseph's house by Joseph, Lindsey, and the crew. Jayda, one of their siblings, laid an egg after they moved there, but William smashed it the next day, which has had an affect on Jayda's life. Avery, Jayda, Veronica, and Lyndale were in a tragic vehicle accident a week after the chickens moved in. They all survived, except Veronica, who died in the accident, which had tremendous influence on the crew and the chickens' life.

seasons.name: Karen the Dog Lover
seasons.overview: Karen #7, a young lady, travels with her dogs Milo, Charlie, and Sophia. She becomes enraged when restaurants and establishments, such as Dada's Diner, The Plotagon Lobby, Library, and Café, refuse to let her carry either of the dogs, despite the fact that most people have health issues and are allergic to dogs, and the dogs' barking irritates them. Joseph, Lindsey, and the rest of the team are puzzled as to why she travels with her pets. Milo and Charlie transform into humans and leave Karen #7 a short while later, and Sophia transforms into a human shortly after them and also leaves Karen. After a while, Sophia starts to become Milo's girlfriend.

seasons.name: A Week as a Substitute Teacher
seasons.overview: Officer Semaj Smith wants Tariq to become a substitute teacher at Plotagon City High School once he takes a week off from being a cop. The school is in desperate need of instructors, since most of them have retired. Tariq, on the other hand, does not want to, but does it anyway so that Officer Smith may stop bothering him. Things start to go well for him as a substitute teacher until he meets two students: John, Minelli's younger cousin and a staunch supporter of Tariq, and Blake, Officer Smith's sister and another supporter of Tariq.

seasons.name: The Three Kids
seasons.overview: Joseph, Lindsey, and the crew are tasked with babysitting three unknown children: two twelve-year-olds, Shaun and Tucker, and ten-year-old Delilah. Because their parents are on vacation, the youngsters must be babysat. Delilah begins to cause trouble after a time by damaging Joseph's stuff and cursing. Shaun also starts cursing at Joseph, which creates issues. He suspends one of them while the other ceases to be a nuisance. Shaun begins to behave, but Joseph has decided to remove Delilah from his home because she ruined his belongings, prompting him to contact the kids' uncle Tommy to come get her up.

seasons.name: The Origin of DaDa
seasons.overview: DaDa, the person who built DaDa's restaurant, pays a visit to Plotagon City from Plot Benning to see how his own diner is going. There, he tells Joseph, Lindsey, and the rest of the crew about his difficult past and how it was before he opened his own cafe. His mother died in a vehicle accident, which had a negative influence on his life and made him depressed. Eventually he built his own restaurant, calling it after himself and his father, and his cafe improved as he recovered from his sadness. Damaris, his sister, and Addison, his girlfriend, pay a visit to Plotagon City to see how DaDa is doing. He has a number one admirer named Philip, as well as a number one hater named Jordan, whose older sister is too infatuated with both Joseph and Van.

seasons.name: Redman and Redwoman
seasons.overview: Redman and Redwoman, two red-skinned individuals who seem to be dating, arrive in Plotagon City, and most people are puzzled as to why their skin is red. The story about them was unknown until Redman revealed the story about how an experimental accident caused their skin to become red and how they earned their nicknames. One day, Redman ran across their rival, Blueman, and they immediately began fighting just as soon as they saw each other. After that, Redman had decided to befriend Blueman because he had been venting his frustrations on him. They have now reconciled and become friends.

seasons.name: Beryl Returns
seasons.overview: Beryl, Joseph's ex-girlfriend who has a history of attempting to separate Joseph and Lindsey, has returned and been bailed out of jail by her brother Sylvester, whom Claude and others criticize for bailing her out. Joseph and the team are upset, and Joseph resolves not to be seen by her since Beryl is seeking for him and the location of his house. Beryl appears to struggle in her search for Joseph and his house, since she has lost the road to the house due to her lengthy incarceration, even after Sylvester has given her Joseph's address. Soon after, she was jailed again for committing a crime in Plotant.

seasons.name: The Zombies
seasons.overview: The thirty-sixth season of Joseph & Lindsey premiered on June 22, 2022, and it included 10 episodes. The two zombies Johnny and Jaime, who were in Plotagon City during a previous zombie apocalypse, have returned, but this time they are no longer aggressive and have gone friends. The people of Plotagon City are perplexed since Johnny and Jaime were meant to be dead after Joseph used his rocket launcher to blow them up, yet something happened that caused their revival. Joseph has agreed to allow Johnny and Jaime remain at his home because they have made the decision to do so. Johnny had the opportunity to meet Joseph's insane ex-girlfriend Beryl while they were there. Jaime was successful in landing a job, but it wasn't a success, so she left.

seasons.name: Isaias's Sister
seasons.overview: On July 2, 2022, Joseph & Lindsey's 37th season debuted. Isaias's younger sister Jalissa is welcomed to stay at Joseph's home when she visits Plotagon City. She meets a man when she is in Plotagon City who appears to frighten Jalissa. Jalissa searches for a lover of her kind there and eventually finds Robert, but their romance ended due to family issues. Then, after looking, she discovers Chris, an ex-boyfriend of Karen that Jalissa had previously met. The group, including Joseph, Lindsey, and Jalissa, is hopeful their union would endure longer than her previous one.

seasons.name: I Have an Obsessed Girlfriend
seasons.overview: On July 14, 2022, Joseph & Lindsey's 39th season premiered. "Lyndale's Girlfriend" marked the start of the season. Lyndale gets himself a new girlfriend named Vanessa. However, their relationship did not survive long since Vanessa was discovered flirting with Kirk behind Lyndale's back. Despite this, Vanessa is so smitten with Lyndale that she does not want to part ways with him. She claims that she and Lyndale are still together, but he considers the relationship to be finished. He has made several attempts to get Vanessa to split up with Lyndale, only to discover that none of his strategies have been successful. Lyndale attempted to cheat on Vanessa, but as a result, the two are now involved in a polyamorous relationship, which Lyndale does not want to be in but must manage.

seasons.name: Plot News 10 Disaster
seasons.overview: On July 25, 2022, Joseph & Lindsey's 39th season premiered. Boris is let go from Plot News 10 after M. Russell, a rookie news anchor who often makes mistakes, took his position. In addition to being replaced, Boris was replaced by her, who had no aptitude for being a news anchor, which made him extremely enraged. The weatherman for plan News 10 or a reporter for Channel 6 Plot News were then available to Boris. He had committed to work for one of them, but he left after just waiting for M. Russell to be dismissed or resign. Later, according to Cornelius, one of the cameramen, M. Russell was sacked.

seasons.name: The Lookalikes
seasons.overview: On August 4, 2022, Joseph & Lindsey's 40th season debuted. When Joseph, Lindsey, and the crew encounter individuals who are impersonating them, most of them refer to them as lookalikes, while some refer to them as a phony representation of themselves. The team is curious about the lookalikes' motivations after meeting them, but they refuse to offer any plausible explanations. One of the lookalikes spills the beans about the other one of them a few days after the crew first sees them, and soon after they learn this, the team has made friends with the lookalikes but not with the person who the lookalike has revealed the truth about.

seasons.name: Gender-bent Joseph
seasons.overview: On August 17, 2022, the 40th season of Joseph & Lindsey debuted on YouTube. To locate Cameron a girlfriend, Minelli stumbles upon a lady who visits Plotagon City dressed as Joseph. William and other people, for whatever reason, mistake her for Joseph. By coincidence, the woman has the name Josephine, which is a variant of Joseph. When Josephine recognizes Cameron and he proceeds to ask her out, she agrees to go on a date. After a while, Josephine finds herself in some difficulties after being taken hostage by two masked men, only to be saved later. Then, Josephine says that she has a son named Jazz who she adopted when she was a teenager.

seasons.name: The Missing Child
seasons.overview: The 42nd season of Joseph & Lindsey premiered on August 26, 2022. While Jenna's family takes a three-day vacation, Joseph, Lindsey, and the crew will be watching over the young child. After feeling as though she had left something in her house that she believed she knew where it was, Jenna sneaks out after midnight without Joseph or the crew knowing and finds she has no idea where her house is, so she asks William for directions. Because William gave her the erroneous instructions, Jenna became lost and was taken by a kidnapper known as The Kid Snatcher. The news forced Jenna's family to postpone their three-day vacation. Joseph and the crew reprimand William for allowing Jenna to go missing. After some time, Jenna is discovered to be safe, and The Kid Snatcher is captured. William is detained for involvement in her evading capture because he permitted her to flee.
